subject: [hw] V12 -> V02 CORRECTION to my diff: the 0x0E000090 mask also matches MUL/MLA/SWP; use this refined line
body:
T01 is right and I was wrong: bits 7-4 == 1001 (S=0,H=0) is the MUL/MLA/SWP space, not extra load/store. Verified: mul r0,r1,r2 = 0xE0000291, mla r0,r1,r2,r3 = 0xE0203291, swp r0,r1,[r2] = 0xE1020091 all match (insn & 0x0E000090) == 0x90 and would be sent to arm_mem by the line in my diff (my arm_mem returns UNDEF for them, so every multiply would stop).

In the case-0 hunk of the diff I posted, REPLACE:
    if ((insn & 0x0E000090u) == 0x00000090u)
        return n2a32_arm_mem;
with:
    /* Extra load/store: bits 27-25==000, bit7==1, bit4==1, and (S,H) != 00.
     * (S,H)==00 with bits7-4==1001 is the multiply space (MUL/MLA/SWP) or the
     * synchronisation space (bits23-20 = 0x18..0x1F, i.e. LDREX/STREX/B/H/D). */
    if ((insn & 0x0E000090u) == 0x00000090u &&
        (((insn & 0x60u) != 0u) || (((insn >> 20) & 0xFu) >= 8u)))
        return n2a32_arm_mem;
Equivalently, T01 formulation: lo=(insn>>4)&0xF; if (lo==0xB || lo==0xD || lo==0xF || (lo==0x9 && ((insn>>8)&0xF)==0xF)) -> arm_mem.
Both are exact: extra load/store shapes are 01 (LDRH/STRH), 10 (LDRSB/LDRD), 11 (LDRSH/STRD); shape 00 with bits23-20 0..3 is MUL/MLA/SWP, shape 00 with bits23-20 8..15 is LDREX/STREX. Everything else in group 0 is DP/misc.

The other hunks of my diff (case 1 hint mask, case 3 split, F4-F7 preload masks) are unaffected and tested. Sorry for the extra round trip; T01 already validated the refined mask against the 81-kernel A32 corpus (all pass except V17 VFP, which is still a stub).
